title: Corroding Beacon
description: A single high, metallic percussion hit sculpted from a struck-metal source layered with a sliver of white noise, fired in a shifting tick pattern. Over 16 cycles it travels from a clean glassy ping into a bit-crushed, downsampled corrosion as the degradation LFOs climb, while a band-pass sweep and panning keep the transient alive.
code:
setcpm(124/4)
stack(
  s("metal*4").n("<0 2 1 3>/2")
    .penv("<18 24 30>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.05)
    .speed(sine.slow(13).range(1.4, 2.6))
    .crush(saw.slow(16).range(16, 4))
    .coarse("<1 1 2 4 8>/8")
    .shape(sine.slow(11).range(0.1, 0.55))
    .bpf(sine.slow(24).range(1200, 6500)).resonance(15)
    .hpf(800)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.1, 0.9))
    .sometimesBy(0.15, x => x.speed(-1))
    .decay(0.12).sustain(0).release(0.04)
    .delay("0.35:0.1875:0.55").room(0.4).orbit(2)
    .gain(0.9)
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(7)).gain(0.3).crush(6))
  ,
  s("white*4").mask("<1 0 1 1>/2")
    .penv(36).pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.03)
    .hpf(sine.slow(17).range(3000, 9000)).resonance(8)
    .coarse(sine.slow(16).range(1, 10))
    .decay(0.04).sustain(0).release(0.02)
    .pan(sine.slow(9).range(0.85, 0.15))
    .gain(0.35)
)
